# Carolina Silva Vidal

Carolina Silva Vidal is a People & Talent leader, founding recruiter, and Founder & People Partner at The People Nook. Based in Benidorm, Spain, she works remotely with startup teams in the US and Europe.

Focus areas: startup hiring, technical recruiting, People Operations, employer branding, and practical AI workflows for recruiting.
